Guides / Hunting / Legendaries & Mythicals

Legendaries & Mythicals

Where every legendary lives, when they wake, and how Mythicals work.

  • Each island has its own legendaries. They only roam once you've beaten that island's Gym and hold 3 badges.
  • They're a small slice of the grass (the rank's legendary weight × 0.33), levelled at the island's top + 4 to + 10, and catch at half rate. Raids are the steady way to farm them.
  • Set Catch rules → Legendaries: "Call me first" to have every wild legendary wait 2 minutes for you.
  • Mythicals (23) never appear in the wild: they come from Raid Eggs (and trades).
  • Legendaries don't breed. Evolutions and forms of a legendary line count as legendary too.
